title.narrative: Contributing to the Decrease of Mortality and Morbidity related to Malaria in Guinea-Bissau - Guinea-Bissau (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Guinea-Bissau, Malaria, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Guinea-Bissau)This program has the following goals: Contribute to reducing malaria-related morbidity and mortality in Guinea-Bissau.. The objectives of this program are: At least 95 percent of the population sleeps under an LLIN by the end of 2020. At least 55 percent of pregnant women receive at least three doses of IPT under direct observation by the end of 2020. At least 90 percent of children aged 3 to 59 months are covered by SMC in the target zones by the end of 2020. At least 99 percent of malaria cases are managed correctly, in accordance with the national protocol, in health care facilities by the end of 2020. Strengthen the management and coordination of the National Malaria Control Program by the end of 2020. Strengthen the Monitoring and Evaluation System by the end of 2020
